jobs.title: AI Researcher ($140K- 300K)
jobs.description:
𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗷𝗼𝗯

This role is for one of our client companies — a VC-backed Artificial Intelligence (AI) startup that has raised $500K USD in funding.
𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘆: $140K- 300K
Apply once and, if selected, get access to up to 20 remote and onsite interview opportunities.

🚀 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴

CodeRound AI matches the top 5% tech talent with the fastest-growing, VC-funded AI startups across Silicon Valley and India.

Top-tier product startups across the US, UK, EU, UAE, and India have hired top engineers through CodeRound.

🚀 𝗔𝗜 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗿 (2+ 𝗬𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲)

We are seeking an AI Researcher & Engineer to push the boundaries of model performance through hands-on experimentation, fine-tuning, and deployment. Join us to bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and production-ready AI products.

🧩 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗗𝗼

Research and understand machine learning techniques and papers
Experiment with new research techniques and real-world implementations
Train, deploy, and serve models at scale
Write research papers based on experiments and findings
Develop detailed benchmarks and comparative performance analyses
Perform quantization and fine-tuning of LLMs and other models
Optimize models and GPU infrastructure for cost-to-scale efficiency
Write Python code and Jupyter Notebooks

✅ 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗿𝗲 𝗮 𝗚𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁 𝗙𝗶𝘁 𝗜𝗳 𝗬𝗼𝘂

Strong AI research background with research/paper publications
Experience researching and implementing machine learning techniques and papers
Strong experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorRT-LLM
Experience training, deploying, and serving models at scale
Experience with quantization and fine-tuning of LLMs and other models
Strong benchmarking and performance analysis experience

✨ 𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗝𝗼𝗶𝗻 𝗨𝘀?

Own the research roadmap from day one at our funded startup.
Deploy cutting-edge AI models directly into production for real-world impact.
Fast-track your career alongside top-tier talent in our Bengaluru office.
Work directly with founders who value bold ideas and rapid execution.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Technology, Information and Media
